name: FlareApp sources
description: The Flare app (2D animation): the SwiftUI App scene, its menu bar (FlareCommands) and views in Sources/FlareApp, including the easing inspector on the live FlareWorkspace, built from SuiteUI, and PlaybackDriver, which feeds NSScreen display-link target timestamps into the workspace's play clock, and StagePath, which turns FlareCore paths and colors into CGPath (one addCurve per cubic) and sRGB CGColor for the stage, and FlareAutosave, which writes the dirty document's RecoveryFile atomically off the main actor once autosave is due and removes it after a save, and on launch reads and decodes it off the main thread into a RecoveryOffer to restore or discard, and FlareWindow, the SuiteWindow with the toolbar, sidebar and inspector that routes every control through one FlareIntent, and FlareToolItems (each FlareTool's palette title, symbol and one-key shortcut), the router (FlareWindow+Router and one FlareWindow+<area> file per FlareIntent area, each acting or giving the reason it can't), and the window's area views: FlareStage (the artboard drawn in a Canvas on CanvasViewport, its overlay of draft, marquee and selection outline, and the floating tool palette), FlareTimeline (one TimelineStrip lane per layer, ruler scrub and the timecode and frame readouts), FlareTransport (start, step, play/pause, end and loop driving PlaybackDriver), FlareRecording (the auto-key recording ring), FlareFilePanels (the open and save panels, the title's dirty dot, and the save and open alerts), FlareInspector (Properties and Library tabs) and the stubs later tasks fill (FlareLibraryPanel and the new sheet, open status and recovery modifiers).
